target.title: fix(anthropic): respect explicit thinkingBudgetTokens zero with nullish coalescing
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where setting `thinkingBudgetTokens: 0` (intended to disable thinking / request zero thinking budget) on the Anthropic transport or provider was silently overridden to the default 1024 by the `||` operator. `0` is a legitimate value that means "no thinking budget," but `0 || 1024` evaluates to `1024`, so the user's explicit intent was lost.

## Why This Change Was Made

Both call sites now use `??` (nullish coalescing) instead of `||` (logical OR), matching the prevailing pattern already used on the adjacent line `options?.thinkingDisplay ?? "summarized"`. This preserves explicit `0` while retaining the `1024` fallback for `undefined` / absent options.

## User Impact

Operators and API callers can now set `thinkingBudgetTokens: 0` to disable Anthropic thinking budget on older (non-adaptive) models. Previously the zero was silently overridden to 1024 with no indication.

## Evidence

**Real behavior proof (10 assertions):**

```
[case 1] thinkingBudgetTokens=0 — explicit zero = disable thinking
  ok: || overrides 0→1024 (BUG)
  ok: ?? preserves 0 (FIX)
  ||: 1024  ??: 0

[case 2] thinkingBudgetTokens=undefined — fallback to default
  ok: || returns 1024
  ok: ?? returns 1024

[case 3-5] explicit non-zero values preserved by both operators
  ALL PASSED

ALL PROOF ASSERTIONS: 10 passed, 0 failed
```

**Negative control:**
```
Main (||): thinkingBudgetTokens=0 → budget_tokens=1024 (BUG: 0 overridden)
Fix  (??): thinkingBudgetTokens=0 → budget_tokens=0 (CORRECT)
exit=42
```

**Regression tests (both files):**
```
src/agents/anthropic-transport-stream.test.ts — 100 passed
packages/ai/src/providers/anthropic.test.ts — all passed
```

**Format:** `oxfmt` clean on both changed files.
